title: Engaging outdoor fun in between Seville and Triana.
text: The kayaking on the Guadalquivir was a fun respite from the usual (though fun) city  visit activities.  Our guide, Benoit, was friendly, responsive to the group’s interests in the city, and his love of the city was obvious and a pleasure to benefit from.

title: Lovely
text: Lovely easy kayak tour.  It doesn’t go very far on the river, but if you’re looking for an easy gentle row, this is for you!
author: nedkiss

title: Kayak tour Seville - city and nature
text: We saw a lot of animals (turtles, fish, ducks, geese) and the guides told a lot of interesting things about the city and the river. They also took pictures of the tour so you didn't have to take your phone with you. It was also pleasant that we were among ourselves. Not a huge group.
author: Martin_M

title: A fantastic way to combine a workout and a history lesson!
text: How often do you get a great workout, stunning scenery, personal instruction AND a history lesson all at once?  The Guadalquivir River kayaking adventure with Sevilla’s Club Deportivo Remo provided all those things, and our guide, Carlos, was the best: a champion kayaker himself, he was a patient instructor and enthusiastic historian and made it an excursion to remember.
author: David_Z

title: Superb way to see the city
text: Superb value. Really interesting to see the city from the river. Paddling both ways was easy as there is very little current/flow in the river.
author: Richard_S

title: Best way to see Seville
text: Juanra was so knowledgeable and extremely friendly and made the experience memorable. He explained the buildings and history in manageable chunks. The time passed so quickly and we also got to see some of the nature.
